name: Партия 3 (предложение, ждёт «да»): значки эффектов боя
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images (approved game art), but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition unless told to.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no runes that look like letters, no real-world alphabets, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture.
cutout_rule: Isolate the subject on a perfectly flat, uniform, solid pure {name} background ({hex}) that fills the whole canvas edge to edge: no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no floor, no cast shadow, no reflection, no glow or light spill on the background, no checkerboard transparency pattern. Leave a clear margin of background around the subject. Do not use {name} or similar colors anywhere in the subject.

effects.frame: Format: battle status-effect badge shown at 20–28 px over a hero card, same family as the approved 'Ward' badge in the first reference image. A circular medallion about 85% of the canvas: thin forged dark-iron rim with a thin glowing line in the rim — teal (#48E5D4) for a helpful effect, rust red (#DC6A52) for a harmful one — a dark stone disc inside, and one bold simple symbol in the center that stays readable at 20 px. The glow stays inside the medallion. No pink or magenta tint.
